title: The Second Copy
premise: At a station's lost-property counter, just before closing, Nia asks you to return the sealed letter she left earlier. You are the attendant. Decide what to ask, whether to promise its return, and whether to give it back, retain it, or leave the decision for tomorrow.

room.name: Lost-property counter
room.description: The station is closing. You have one letter left to return.

object.name: Sealed letter
object.description: One envelope, left behind earlier today.
